description: Check whether the site's page appears in AI search for each target search, at which position, and which sites appear in its place, with plain recommendations. Uses the saved searches or the ones the page suggests when queries is omitted. Send {} to use the saved searches, or the searches the page title and H1 suggest; send {queries} to choose. One index check plus one search per query, each USD 0.00075 when it returns results. A run with the same searches in the last 24 hours comes back with reused: true and no cost. Without a watch package: one run per week, three searches. With one: twenty runs per UTC day, ten searches. Result titles and snippets are third-party data.

queries.description: Optional. One to ten searches, 1 to 128 characters each.
